verdict.rationale: OCI's own API docs state a deprecation-notice policy: 12 months advance notice before removing or changing an existing API in a way that would require code changes. The pack only describes the APIs as typical REST APIs and never documents an API versioning scheme. missing for 10: evidence of explicit API versioning (version identifiers or paths, version lifecycle), detail on how deprecations are communicated, independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is honored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure provides 12 months advance notice before the date of removing or changing an existing API of a Cloud Service that you have deployed which would require you to update the code.
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure APIs are typical REST APIs that use HTTPS requests and responses.
